criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Person
categories.definition: An individual human being, including historical figures, politicians, artists, athletes, and other professionals.

categories.name: Organization
categories.definition: An organized body of people with a particular purpose, including companies, institutions, government bodies, and non-profit groups.

categories.name: Geographic Feature
categories.definition: A natural physical feature of the Earth's surface, such as a mountain, lake, river, or crater.

categories.name: Settlement
categories.definition: A permanent human settlement, such as a city, town, or village.

categories.name: Creative Work
categories.definition: A distinct artistic or intellectual creation, including films, books, albums, television series, and video games.

categories.name: Biological Taxon
categories.definition: A group of one or more populations of an organism or organisms seen by taxonomists to form a unit.

categories.name: Vehicle
categories.definition: A machine used for transportation, including automobiles, trains, aircraft, and watercraft.

categories.name: Building or Structure
categories.definition: A man-made structure, including buildings, historic sites, monuments, and architectural elements.

categories.name: Educational Institution
categories.definition: An institution dedicated to education, including schools, colleges, and universities.
